name: Maddox Ranch House Warm Homemade Dinner Rolls with Sweet Corn & Raspberry Butter
brandOrRestaurant: Maddox Ranch House (Perry / Brigham City — Hwy 89 to Logan & Bear Lake)
whyItWorks: Pillowy, feather-light homemade white yeast rolls served piping hot at the table—an iconic Utah comfort staple.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the warm homemade white rolls with plain honey butter (or a light dab of raspberry honey butter if seed-strained) and skip the whole-kernel sweet corn dish if flaring.
watchOuts: Skip the side dish of whole-kernel sweet corn during flares (insoluble hulls)
